declarations.type:
∀ {initial : SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopState} {snapshot : SearchRouteInspectCertifiedLedger.RankedDAGSnapshot}
  {source target : Fin snapshot.graph.nodeCount} {requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement}
  {budget : SearchRouteDAG.GraphRouteBudget} {selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate}
  (ledger :
    SearchRouteInspectCertifiedLedger.CertifiedTraceLedger initial snapshot source target requirement budget selected),
  (∃ entry, entry ∈ ledger.visibleCatalog ∧ entry.candidate = selected) ∧
    SearchRouteDAG.Realizes snapshot.graph source target selected ∧
      ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
        SearchRouteDAG.Realizes snapshot.graph source target candidate →
          SearchRouteDAG.graphFeasibleB requirement budget candidate = true →
            SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse selected candidate
